debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting.

api_host.description: IP address the Ironic API server binds to.

api_port.description: Port the Ironic API server listens on.

api_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the Ironic API service.

auth_strategy.description: Authentication strategy: 'keystone' for integration with OpenStack Identity, or 'noauth' for development/testing.

enable_ssl_api.description: Enable TLS/HTTPS for the Ironic API endpoint.

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (required if TLS is enabled).

ssl_key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file (required if TLS is enabled).

ssl_ca_file.description: Path to the CA certificate bundle for client verification (optional).

default_conductor_group.description: Default conductor group for bare metal nodes without a specific assignment.

default_power_interface.description: Default power management interface (e.g., ipmitool, redfish).

default_management_interface.description: Default management interface (typically matches power interface).

default_boot_interface.description: Default boot interface for node provisioning.

keystone_endpoint_type.description: Keystone endpoint type used by Ironic: 'public', 'internal', or 'admin'.

keystone_project_name.description: Project (tenant) name for Ironic's service user in Keystone.

keystone_password.description: Password for Ironic's Keystone service user. *Do not expose in plaintext.*

keystone_insecure.description: Disable TLS certificate verification for Keystone communication (not recommended in production).

db_connection.description: Database connection string. Supports SQLite for development: 'sqlite:////var/lib/ironic/ironic.sqlite'.

db_max_pool_size.description: Maximum number of database connections in the pool.

db_max_overflow.description: Maximum number of additional connections beyond the pool.

db_pool_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for acquiring a database connection.

publish_errors_enabled.description: Enable publishing of Ironic errors as notifications on the message bus.

conductor_task_processing_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) a task can remain unprocessed before being requeued.

conductor_heartbeat_timeout.description: Seconds after last heartbeat before a conductor is considered offline.

agent_api_url.description: Base URL for the Ironic Inspector API.

agent_connect_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) when connecting to the agent on a node.

agent_call_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for agent operations to complete.

image_download_chunk_size.description: Chunk size (bytes) for downloading images via agent.

ipxe_enabled.description: Enable iPXE boot instead of legacy PXE (for advanced boot control).

ipxe_menu_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) before iPXE boots the default menu entry.

tftp_server_ip.description: IP address of the TFTP server (must be reachable by bare metal nodes).

tftp_root_dir.description: Root directory for TFTP files (e.g., PXE boot images).

pxe_bootfile_name.description: Name of the BIOS PXE boot file (for legacy BIOS nodes).

pxe_uefi_bootfile_name.description: Name of the UEFI PXE boot file (for UEFI-capable nodes).

dns_lookup_enabled.description: Enable DNS resolution for nodes via dnsmasq.

neutron_project_name.description: Project name for Ironic in Neutron (for port management).

neutron_password.description: Password for Ironic's Neutron service user.

neutron_insecure.description: Disable TLS verification for Neutron API.

inspector_enabled.description: Enable hardware inspection via Ironic Inspector.

inspector_url.description: URL of the Ironic Inspector API.

inspector_auth_type.description: Authentication type for Inspector API: 'keystone' or 'noauth'.

node_type.description: Logical group name for node types (e.g., 'compute', 'storage', 'baremetal').

drivers.description: Interface driver overrides for this node type.
